title: NACD Directors Summit 2026: Eric Ries on the mainstage
summary: Eric gives a mainstage session on Incorruptible at the National Association of Corporate Directors' annual Directors Summit (October 11 to 14, Gaylord National Harbor, outside Washington, DC; 1,700+ board directors). Tuesday October 13 in Potomac A, Mainstage III (8:30 to 10:50 a.m. ET), between NACD's State of the Association and a fireside with Mark Weinberger. NACD's own session description frames the book's argument for a board audience: mission drift as a design flaw rather than an ethical lapse, and organizational integrity as a practical design problem.
blockquote: Mission drift isn't an accident; it is a design flaw that threatens even the most successful organizations.
blockquote_source: NACD Directors Summit 2026 agenda, session description: Incorruptible: Why Good Companies Go Bad and How Great Companies Stay Great
